items.title: 67426_Hayes Pillars oral history interview
items.q: let a booking agent book Dizzy Gillespie in for that three weeks

ctx.x: -- and went to Jersey, yes. Then our

trip ended in New York City. And we had booked our band back in the Club Riviera. We had given Mr. Chambers the first three weeks of fall, in St. Louis. He took advantage of us, and let a booking agent book Dizzy Gillespie in for that three weeks, and that made us have to lay off for three weeks. And when all the band came back off of vacation, see, they all had a vacation in August, in July.
